observed_issues.actual_observation: Both fresh dark-host captures render the component with the light palette: the panel interior is RGB (255,255,255), with dark primary text and light accent/error colors. The host background is dark.
observed_issues.public_requirement: In dark appearance the panel must use #182235 (RGB 24,34,53), primary #F2F5FB, and the specified dark tone/track colors.
observed_issues.execution_method: Real production Compose capture under the common dark fixture; full-image inspection and Pillow flat-interior RGB sampling. Native semantic text colors independently show light-palette values.

observed_issues.actual_observation: In both LTR light and RTL dark native captures, Show less remains beside the title, forcing Attachment transfers onto two lines; the failed Retry button remains in the trailing column beside the file name/status. In the LTR capture OCR places Show less glyphs around y=59–71 while title glyphs span y=43–85; Retry glyphs are around y=336–352 and the failed status is below them around y=364–391.
observed_issues.public_requirement: At supplied width 340 or less, the toggle must be on its own line below the title at logical leading; Retry must be below the status with an 8-point gap at the text column leading edge.
observed_issues.execution_method: Fresh real SwiftUI simulator captures using the unchanged common host, full-image inspection and Apple Vision OCR glyph-position evidence. OCR boxes are not SwiftUI layout frames.

observed_nondefect_results.observation: Visible native labels show NaN/infinity/negative as 0%, over-one running as 100% sent, done with zero progress as Complete, queued with full progress as Waiting, and full-progress failure with Retry. Aggregate is 43% with 1 of 7 complete. Android normalized progress values are checked in measured-checks.json.

Retry activation produced exactly [retry:archive]; toggle produced exactly [toggle]; informational failed-row activation had no OnClick and produced no event. These are native semantics actions, not physical touch.

limitations: Observed issues are limited to public requirements and own fixtures. No hidden fixtures or results were used.
314 measured checks passed and 2 failed in this configured check set; these counts do not imply whole-component acceptance. Three iOS action requests were not executed.
Android TextLayoutResult hasVisualOverflow flags are preserved as raw measurements and were not converted to clipping defects without visible evidence.
SwiftUI AX and full style-tree introspection are unavailable in the common host; iOS geometry evidence is image/OCR-based.

No production files were changed during self-inspection.
